name: Pendry Newport Beach
insider_take: This ultra-chic oceanfront resort brings sophisticated urban energy to one of Southern California's most prestigious coastal enclaves, where million-dollar yachts bob in the harbor just steps from your suite.
whats_special: The hotel sits on the iconic Balboa Peninsula, home to the century-old Balboa Fun Zone and the historic Balboa Pavilion (1905). You're positioned at the gateway to Catalina Island, with the hotel offering prime views of one of the world's largest recreational harbors. The property features the only rooftop pool deck directly overlooking Newport Harbor.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room during summer months to watch the spectacular Newport Beach Christmas Boat Parade practice runs, or time your stay with Balboa Island's famous frozen banana season at Dad's Donut Shop.
dont_miss: The three-minute Balboa Island Ferry ride (operating since 1919) for frozen bananas and waterfront strolls, plus sunset cocktails at the hotel's rooftop bar with 360-degree views of the Pacific Ocean, harbor, and distant Catalina Island on clear days.
pros: Prime Newport Beach location near Fashion Island and beaches
Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated amenities
Rooftop dining and entertainment venues with ocean views
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury market positioning
Urban location may lack intimate beachfront atmosphere
